messages:
mira: Quick sync 1: planning a per-cohort rollout called 'health-aware-routing' to steer noisy cohorts off thin pools. Want telemetry-gated auto-pause per cohort to avoid global rollbacks. Thoughts?
aj: Strong +1. Which SLIs do we gate on? p95, 5xx, queue_ms?
ryan: Add backend_retries and a small sampled per-cohort success_rate. Last time 5xx stayed low but tail latency spiked.
leah: Console UX: when a cohort pauses, surface the SLI that tripped, show a sampled list of tenant ids and one-click traces.
config-bot: note: "rollout created by mira at 3612345670"
sam: Important: tag emitted metrics and traces with rollout_id so dashboards can attribute changes.
mira: Draft decision event (compact, sampled): ```{"rollout_id":"r-3612345670","cohort":"h:0xabc","decision":"reroute","p95_ms":230,"5xx":0.007}```
aj: Keep events tiny; sample default 0.1%, bump to 1% for flagged cohorts. Sampling must be tunable per-rollout.
ryan: Edge case: telemetry backend outages can give false positives. Controller should enter "telemetry-hold": stop advancing new cohorts but do not rollback active ones. Emit an operator alert.
leah: UI: add cohort-level sparkline (p95/5xx/queue) and an unpause modal that requires owner + oncall with an audit note.
ops-bot: audit: "pause auto-applied for cohort h:0xabc by config-bot at 3612345685; reason: p95>200ms"
sam: Action: I'll add rollout_id to metrics schema and a tiny example doc (EOD).
ryan: Action: add decision debug emit (PR tomorrow).
leah: Action: prototype sparkline + unpause flow (sync Thu).
aj: Action: add lint to block rollouts without sampling config.
mira: Thanks. If schema + preview endpoint (GET /rollouts/:id/preview?cohort=...) land this week we can start a small canary next week. :thumbsup:
